capabilities: Score note health from recency, connections, and word count
Visualize per-folder health, freshness, and connection maps
Filter and open notes by health category
Configure scoring weights, grace periods, and excluded folders
extras: Release files include GitHub build-provenance attestations with a verification command; the README notes physical iOS/Android testing remains advisable and that file modification times can shift after sync or restore, affecting recency scores.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to see which notes have gone stale, are orphaned, or need maintenance across a large vault.
summary: Local dashboard that scores each note's maintenance health from recency, link count, and word count, and flags stale or forgotten notes.
